title: 验收 P1 缓存与轮询治理

originalAcceptance.criterion: 空闲 5 分钟 spawn 次数较基线下降 ≥80%
evidence: Both pure-idle runs observed only the same startup spawns; no repeated git.status reads occurred, so there was nothing for the cache to reduce.

correctedAcceptance.criterion: 受控 1s git.status 5 分钟只读工作负载下，spawn 次数较 pre-P1 下降 ≥80%
同 key 并发只触发 1 次真实调用
evidence: pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/git-api.test.ts tests/unit/resource-p1-schedulers.test.ts: 58/58 passed.
tests/unit/git-api.test.ts covers concurrent status reads issuing one git status and one repo probe.
pnpm agent-dev:fast exit 0; 7 files / 88 tests passed; contract and i18n lint passed.

acceptanceCorrection.reason: The original criterion assumed idle background git reads. The real idle app produced 7/7 startup spawns, so the measured controlled 1s read workload is the only path that exercises the cache under test.
acceptanceCorrection.notClaimed: This receipt does not claim a pure-idle spawn reduction.

gates.command: pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/git-api.test.ts tests/unit/resource-p1-schedulers.test.ts

boundaries: The controlled workload calls git.status once per second through the renderer host bridge; it is not a pure-idle claim.
The pure-idle before/after pair is retained as counter-evidence and both counts are 7.
The pre-P1 build is an instrumentation-only cherry-pick at a41d68cf; the after build is the landed P1 main at 4a781ba4.
No git writes occur during either controlled run, so invalidation is not exercised by this benchmark.
All evidence is agent-driven and local-only; no real-human evidence is claimed.
